vitest-duration-sharding.reason: The published image installs workspace dependencies but has no packages/vitest/dist/cli.js. Copy relative workspace links, build candidate packages using the public root build script, then run the core/thread suite selected by the public root test script using the candidate-built CLI. This is not the broader test:ci schedule. The offline build was verified with an 8 GB writable temporary filesystem.

kea-atomic-signal-selectors.reason: The public test:jest script sets BABEL_ENV=test, enabling its Babel test transforms. The image also forces NODE_ENV=production, which disables React's act helper; set NODE_ENV=test to restore Jest's normal test environment. Run the complete configured Jest suite without excluding tests.

sql-formatter-bigquery-pipe-formatting.reason: The public test script generates src/parser/grammar.ts with nearleyc before Jest. Generate it from the candidate grammar.ne using the installed compiler, rather than borrowing the image's generated parser or disabling TypeScript diagnostics.

mnamer-daemon-watch-lifecycle.reason: The clean candidate snapshot excludes Git history and the untracked version file. Restore only the published image's mnamer/__version__.py stub (0.0.0) when absent, matching its existing test environment rather than inventing a version; keep candidate source first on PYTHONPATH and retain any candidate-provided version file.

yjs-map-conflict-detection.reason: The public entry point uses lib0/testing without a structured reporter. Wrap its registered functions to record CTRF outcomes while the original runner retains filtering, repetitions, seeds and skips. Copy installed dependencies so the relative @y/y self-link resolves to the candidate checkout.

claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegati.reason: The root Electron package has no test script; backend and frontend each declare a Vitest suite. Run both from the candidate packages and namespace their JUnit test IDs.

quill-shared-toolbar-focus.reason: The root package delegates to packages/quill. Run its declared browser unit and jsdom fuzz suites with their own configs. Playwright end-to-end tests require a separate web-server build and are outside this public regression schedule.

cliffy-config-file-parsing.reason: deno.json declares deno test with subprocess, environment, read and local write permissions. Use its built-in JUnit reporter and the published dependency cache, copied to writable temporary storage; cached-only preserves offline execution.

ink-grid-box-layout.reason: package.json declares AVA and the published image installs tap-junit. Rebuild the candidate package before running AVA's TAP output through that installed converter. A failed build is a harness failure, never a passing baseline.

kysely-window-grouping-helpers.reason: Build the candidate library and Node tests before Mocha. The public test setup exposes DIALECTS; select sqlite because the pinned image has no running PostgreSQL, MySQL or MSSQL services. Collect the existing SQLite and dialect-independent tests through Mocha JSON; this is a narrower public schedule, not the full multi-database suite.

bandit-structured-nosec-directives.reason: Bandit's test configuration and published image use stestr, with subunit2junitxml installed for JUnit output. The image does not install pytest, so the generic Python runner cannot execute the existing public suite.

csstree-shorthand-expansion-compression.reason: The pinned Mocha 9.2.2 image emits an empty xUnit report for this otherwise healthy suite. Its built-in JSON reporter records the same per-test outcomes without adding a dependency.

true-myth-iterable-collection-combinator.reason: The suite's Vitest typecheck writes tsbuildinfo into its installed package under /app/node_modules, which is read-only. Copying only the 1.7 MB Vitest package into the writable candidate node_modules lets the same typecheck and test suite run unchanged.

awilix-async-container-initialization.reason: src/__tests__/rollup.test.ts requires ../../lib/awilix, the output of `npm run build`, which is not in the repository; the file cannot load in any checkout and jest reports no test for it, so the run's exit code and report disagree.

fastapi-implicit-head-options.reason: pyproject.toml makes every warning an error; uv.lock pins starlette 0.52.1 but the published image installs 1.2.1, which warns when it falls back to httpx, so collection fails before any test runs. Only that warning class is ignored.

prometheus-transactional-reload-status.reason: The published image warms and documents GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/prometheus as the offline test target for this task, with GOFLAGS=-mod=mod. Workspace mode rejects that image flag, and the broader go.work suite includes unrelated packages that fail to build offline. Its 2.5 GB warmed Go cache must be copied into writable temporary storage before testing the candidate checkout; the default 4 GB temporary filesystem ran out of room, while 8 GB produced 82 passing tests.

prometheus-typed-label-sorting.reason: The existing sort_by_label implementation and its tests live under promql. The whole go.work suite includes a tools-only module and unrelated packages that do not build offline in this image, so it produces no usable report. The promql package tree tests the task's candidate code directly.

returns-validated-error-accumulation.reason: setup.cfg injects pytest-cov and pytest-mypy command-line options, but the published image does not install those plugins. Those options make pytest exit during argument parsing before any tests run; clearing only addopts leaves the repository's test discovery and test code unchanged.
